Name: Zadie
Flavor: Can keep a secret. Cannot keep her ears from pointing at it.

Name: Wumplett
Flavor: Falls with remarkable confidence.

Name: Vesna
Flavor: Planted a carrot for tomorrow. Dug it up to check.

Name: Torin
Flavor: Insists he is not lost. This is exploratory hiding.

Name: Terrance
Flavor: Has a very stern voice. It comes out as a squeak.

Name: Tamsin
Flavor: Says she has a system. The system is hopping.

Name: Stellan
Flavor: Stands very still when thinking. Often mistaken for furniture.

Name: Sneikhums
Flavor:
Once Sneika. Now Sneikhums.
Totally unrelated to Mieka and Chieka. Obviously.

Name: Saskia
Flavor: Practiced a terrifying glare. Everyone said it was precious.

Name: Runa
Flavor: Her lucky button has survived everything. Her coat has not.

Name: Quibnock
Flavor: The noise was supposed to happen. The smoke is a surprise.

Name: Pita
Flavor: Round, warm, and offended by the sandwich jokes.

Name: Percy
Flavor: A gentleman always holds the door. Preferably shut.

Name: Oswin
Flavor: Brought a map. It is a napkin with a carrot on it.

Name: Orla
Flavor: Collected three lucky pennies and one deeply unlucky Dog.

Name: Oona
Flavor: Counts friends before leaving. Counts snacks twice.

Name: Nerys
Flavor: Knows seventeen knots. All of them are in her shoelaces.

Name: Mieka
Flavor: Chieka? Sneikhums? Such common, completely unrelated names.

Name: Max
Flavor: Maximum courage. Minimum understanding of the situation.

Name: Lenny
Flavor: Both ears work. Neither takes advice.

Name: Leif
Flavor: Disguised himself as a shrub. Ate the disguise.

Name: Katie
Flavor: Keeps emergency biscuits in the emergency biscuit pocket.

Name: Jonald
Flavor: Voted himself captain. Lost the recount.

Name: JoAnn
Flavor: Has enough snacks for everyone. Please stop inviting Dogs.

Name: Jesse
Flavor: Claims to be fearless. Has not been told about Dogs.

Name: James
Flavor: The next great game is just around the corner.

Name: Ivo
Flavor: Invented the carrot detector. It is his mouth.

Name: Isolde
Flavor: Writes farewell letters before crossing puddles.

Name: Florian
Description: Burrow: When a Chase starts against your other Bun, you may draw 1 Survival card. If it's a Panic card, you may play it in that Chase. Discard it if you don't play it.
Flavor: Brought flowers to the chase. Nobody said what to bring.

Name: Emrys
Flavor: Read a book about bravery. Skipped the scary bits.

Name: Elowen
Flavor: Would stop to smell the flowers. Has eaten most of them.

Name: Eira
Flavor: Mistook the fog for a hiding place she could take home.

Name: Eddie
Flavor: Built a shortcut. It is considerably longer now.

Name: Dorian
Flavor: Refuses to panic until his waistcoat is straight.

Name: Chieka
Flavor: Has never met Mieka. Except at every family dinner.

Name: Bram
Flavor: Names every hiding place. Currently inside Gerald.

Name: Astrith
Flavor: The goggles are for science. The screaming is also for science.

Name: Anouk
Flavor: Her backup plan has a tiny backup hat.

Name: Amy
Flavor: Apologizes to doors after running into them.

Name: Alex
Flavor: Packed a spare carrot in case the first one gets lonely.

Name: Alaric
Flavor: The title is Lord Alaric. The throne is a bucket.

Name: Aisling
Flavor: Dreams big. Hides small.

Name: AJ
Flavor: The plan has two steps. AJ has forgotten both.

Name: Vex
Flavor: Barked at a birthday cake until the candles went out.

Name: Vesper
Flavor: Waits until bedtime. Likes the pajamas.

Name: Skarn
Flavor: Chewed through the warning sign. Felt it lacked bite.

Name: Scourge
Flavor: Fetch is more exciting when the ball begs.

Name: Rotfang
Flavor: His breath arrived first. We should have listened to it.

Name: Rictus
Flavor: That is not a smile. Please stop smiling back.

Name: Mordra
Flavor: Growled at a lullaby. The singer apologized.

Name: Malgrim
Flavor: He likes his dinner frightened. Saves on seasoning.

Name: Harrow
Flavor: Dug up the vegetable patch. Was disappointed by the vegetables.

Name: Gristle
Flavor: Thinks tenderness is a cooking instruction.

Name: Gallows
Flavor: The collar jingles. That is the polite part.

Name: Dreadwick
Flavor: Knocked once. With the entire door.

Name: Blackmaw
Flavor: The tunnel had teeth. We have revised the map.

Name: Your Table Is Ready
Flavor: Your place is set. You appear to be the main course.

Name: The Perfect Carrot
Flavor: Straight, shiny, and suspiciously attached to a string.

Name: The Easy Way
Flavor: No hills, no stairs, no obvious survivors.

Name: Sweet Music
Flavor: Follow the tune. Ignore the chewing between verses.

Name: Special Delivery
Flavor: Nobody remembered ordering impending doom.

Name: Something Shiny
Flavor: A remarkable number of bad decisions begin with ooh.

Name: On the House
Flavor: Free lunch! Terms and teeth apply.

Name: Just One More
Flavor: One for the road. One for the trap. Wait.

Name: I'm a Genius!
Flavor: The bait is free if you don't count the consequences.

Name: Help Yourself
Flavor: The invitation did not specify to what.

Name: Finders Keepers
Flavor: Finders keepers. Keepers screamers.

Name: Come In, It's Warm
Flavor: So is an oven. An unhelpful thought, really.

Name: Almost Had It
Flavor: Next time, catch the carrot before the carrot catches you.

Name: A Little Closer
Flavor: The carrot hasn't moved. The shadows have.

Name: A Cry for Help
Flavor: That voice sounds hungry. Probably just tired.

Name: Your Stop
Flavor: You never said the carriage had to stop too.

Name: Wrong Address
Flavor: I forwarded your invitation to dinner. And your address.

Name: Watch Your Step
Flavor: That was the step. The one you just stepped on.

Name: Under the Wheels
Flavor: A terrible place to discover your hat is too tall.

Name: Tied Up
Flavor: Friendship is a bond. This one is a knot.

Name: The Scent of Friendship
Flavor: A little perfume. So he remembers you.

Name: Take the Long Way
Flavor: A scenic route. Lovely view of the approaching Dog.

Name: Sorry About That
Flavor: A lovely apology. Excellent projection. Still running.

Name: Slippery Courtesy
Flavor: After you. I insist. I have buttered the way.

Name: Ring for Trouble
Flavor: Service is prompt. Service has teeth.

Name: One Seat Left
Flavor: My carrot is sitting there. Sorry.

Name: No Room in the Basket
Flavor: There is room. I just prefer legroom.

Name: Mind the Gap
Flavor: I did mind it. That is why I put you there.

Name: Members Only
Flavor: Membership closed approximately one Dog ago.

Name: Lighten the Load
Flavor: We all have to make sacrifices. Yours is being volunteered.

Name: Last Boat Out
Flavor: Wave goodbye! Preferably with both paws off the boat.

Name: Hold This
Flavor: It isn't heavy. The consequences are.

Name: Going Up Alone
Flavor: The lift has a strict weight limit of me.

Name: Free Carrot-Q
Flavor: The invitation said bring a Bun. We misunderstood.

Name: Follow the Carrot
Flavor: Trust me. I look almost exactly like someone trustworthy.

Name: Draw the Teeth
Flavor: I said distract him, not introduce yourself!

Name: Cut Loose
Flavor: The rope was holding us back. Also holding you up.

Name: Bridge Out
Flavor: I saved you the trouble of crossing it.

Name: Borrowed Hiding Place
Flavor: Finders keepers. Previous occupants outside.

Name: An Unhelpful Foot
Flavor: Oh dear. My foot has betrayed us both. Mostly you.

Name: After You, Dear
Flavor: Such lovely manners. Such conveniently short witnesses.

Name: After You
Flavor: Manners are important. Especially as a head start.

Name: A Little Push
Flavor: Just the encouragement you didn't need.

Name: Wrong Turn, Big Guy
Flavor: Yes, the Buns definitely went toward the very solid wall.

Name: Up, Up, and Away
Flavor: The screaming gets quieter with altitude. How peaceful.

Name: Up You Go
Flavor: Ears are handles in emergencies. This is an emergency.

Name: This Way!
Flavor: Follow the ears! Not those ears! The friendly ears!

Name: The Long Reach
Flavor: One paw short of sensible. Just long enough for a friend.

Name: The Last Rung
Flavor: Please remain attached to your paws at all times.

Name: Stay With Me
Flavor: You can be terrified on the way. Come on!

Name: Safe Landing
Flavor: We promised soft. We did not promise graceful.

Name: Room for Two
Flavor: Three, if nobody breathes. Let's stick with two.

Name: Quiet as a Mouse
Flavor: The mouse would like you to stop blaming it.

Name: Over Here, Ugly!
Flavor: An excellent diversion. A terrible career choice.

Name: Out of Scent
Flavor: Smells like victory. Also onions. Mostly onions.

Name: One More Leap
Flavor: The next rooftop is closer if you close your eyes. Apparently.

Name: Mind Your Head
Flavor: Your thoughts are tiny, but we would like to keep them.

Name: Make a Little Room
Flavor: Move your tail. No, your other fluffy bit.

Name: Leave the Bag
Flavor: But my emergency carrot has an emergency carrot in there!

Name: Keep Him Busy
Flavor: Ask about his favorite bone. Pretend to take notes.

Name: Home Before Dark
Flavor: Count the ears. Divide by two. Put the kettle on.

Name: Hold the Gate
Flavor: A heroic stand. Mostly on somebody else's toes.

Name: Helping Paw
Flavor: No charge. You can owe me a biscuit when we stop shaking.

Name: Dinner Is Served
Flavor: A full Dog is a problem for after lunch.

Name: Borrow My Wings
Flavor: Please return with all feathers and the original Bun.

Name: Behind Me
Flavor: I am extremely small. Stand behind me anyway.

Name: All Aboard
Flavor: Tickets, please! Screaming counts as a ticket!

Name: A Timely Snip
Flavor: A close shave, but farther down the rope.

Name: A Coat of Kindness
Flavor: It is a little big. So is the kindness.

Name: A Bridge Between Friends
Flavor: Trust is important. So are the nails.

Name: Too Cute To Eat
Flavor: Even evil occasionally needs a minute.

Name: Suddenly, Soap!
Flavor: Clean paws. Dirty language.

Name: Spring into Action
Flavor: The landing is tomorrow's problem. Possibly this afternoon's.

Name: Roof Runner
Flavor: The chimney sweep charges extra for pawprints on the sky.

Name: Pull in Case of Dog
Flavor: Finally, instructions even a panicking Bun can follow.

Name: Pocket Full of Pepper
Flavor: Bless you! Please point your blessing somewhere else!

Name: No Brakes
Flavor: Good news: we found the bell.

Name: Millrace Dash
Flavor: The water is moving much too confidently.

Name: Market Scramble
Flavor: Three turnips, a cabbage, and absolutely no dignity.

Name: Look! A Squirrel!
Flavor: It has gears. He has not noticed.

Name: Just Wide Enough
Description: +3 to escape roll versus Reckless Dogs
Flavor: Exhale. Flatten ears. Renegotiate breakfast.

Name: Hidey Hole
Flavor: Luxury accommodation. No headroom. Excellent no-Dog policy.

Name: Emergency Bunbrella
Flavor: Forecast: teeth. Scattered screaming. Sudden relief.

Name: Eat My Coat!
Flavor: Dry-clean only. Good luck with that.

Name: Bun in a Tin
Flavor: Not canned food. Very important distinction.

Name: Safe and Sound
Description: return function() return {"Apply Cozy to your chased Roaming Bun."}; end
